indicator_name: Depreciation of tangible fixed assets during the year
description: Начисленный износ (амортизация) основных средств за год
methodology: Billion KZT, depreciation charged during the year. Tangible fixed assets («Основные средства», Taldau term 455728, intangibles excluded) of all enterprises, form 11, national, from 2000. Historical-cost book values incl. revaluations -- not a volume measure. Taldau 703220.
